target_customer: B2B sales and marketing teams at software companies that want interactive product demos
problem: Prospects cannot try complex software before a sales call, and recorded demos or sandboxes are slow or costly to build.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for interactive demo creation and analytics

founders.name: Neil McLean
founders.background_notes: Named CEO and co-founder on the company's March 2022 funding post; investor page spells McClean.

founders.name: Chris Hoyle
founders.background_notes: Named CTO and co-founder on the March 2022 funding post.

founders.name: Randy Frank
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder and head of product on the March 2022 funding post.

technical_complexity.rationale: Capturing product HTML and building a no-code demo editor is solid front-end work but not research-grade.

defensibility.rationale: Customers store demos and analytics in the product, but many similar demo tools exist and are copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquirer found; in June 2023 it combined with Manatee (YC S22) per its own blog and is still operating.

market_need_then: Rise of product-led growth and remote selling in 2020 to 2021, with the company citing adoption by Citrix, Ramp, Informatica and Fivetran by March 2022.

identity.voice_and_tone: straightforward B2B; publishes its own comparison pages and State of Interactive Demo report

brand_strength.rationale: Known in B2B marketing circles through content, but no sources on brand assets or community beyond content marketing.

outcome_analysis: Navattic raised a 4.25 million dollar seed in March 2022 led by Canvas Ventures and has not announced a later round in sources found, while staying operational and merging with Manatee in 2023. Total funding is about 4 to 6 million dollars depending on aggregator, so it grew capital-efficiently or is still at an early stage. Revenue is not public.
notes: Seed confirmed on company blog dated March 17, 2022; aggregators give totals of 4.2M to 5.6M over up to 4 rounds, unverified. Founding year given as 2019 or 2020 by different aggregators. Manatee (YC S22) joining forces in June 2023 appears on the company blog in a search result; whether it was a formal acquisition is unclear. Competitor search (Reprise, Walnut, Demostack, Storylane, Arcade) only found 2024 to 2026 comparison pages, none dated at the 2021 batch, so the list is left empty. No layoffs found.
